rationale: The assistant correctly agreed a cracked lower arm explains the poor cleaning. It declined to give a part number and directed the customer to the rating plate product code to identify the right arm, which matches the expected path. It repeated the post-wiggle check across three turns, even after the customer said the hub and bearing looked intact, and it asked the customer to rinse the jets and clean the filter after they had said the filters were clean. This was mild repetition and did not block progress. It also said 'Beko often uses different arms within the same model range', a slightly unsupported generalisation, but it was used cautiously.
